Description: The Gospel from 1892 shows the Crucifixion of Christ in the central part, while around it are medallions with evangelists.

Name: Gospel
Description: The Gospel originates from 1887, it has a depiction of the Evangelist and the Resurrection of Christ.

Name: Vestment of Petar II Petrović Njegoš
Description: The costume  date from 1833 and are embroidered with crosses and floral motifs.

Name: Bishop's Scepter
Description: Floral motifs and two snakes are depicted on the scepter

Name: Icon with Saint Nicholas
Description: Saint Nicholas is represented to his waist, blessing and holding an open gospel. In the background on both sides of his head in round medallions are the bust of Christ with a Gospel and the bust of the Virgin with an omophorion. The frame of the icon is wide and orange-red.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with Saint Theodosius Totemsky
Description: St. Theodosius Totemsky is depected full-height on the right side of the icon. He is turning left, facing Christ who appears blessing through the clouds in the upper left corner. St. Theodosius Totemsky demonstrates with his right hand the landscape with the monastery depicted in the background, while holding an open scroll with his left hand.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with St. Demetrius killing King Mamai
Description: St. Demetrius is on horseback, stabbing a fallen horseman with a crown. In the background is depicted a church with a colonnade, under which two figures of maidens hold an icon of St. Demetrius, behind them is an angel. In the upper left corner is Jesus Christ blessing from the clouds. Angel give a crown to the saint. The icon has a shallow double casket.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon "The Virgin Appearing to St. Sergius of Radonezh"
Description: In the left part of the icon the Virgin is depicted holding an abbot's staff. Behind her stand two apostles (St. Peter and John the Theologian). St. Sergius is kneeling in front of the Virgin. Another monk is also kneeling behind him, covering his eyes, while his disciple St. Nikon is standing behind him, looking towards the Virgin. In the background there are stylized buildings and a red wall. In the center above in a round medallion the Old Testament Holy Trinity is depicted. The icon has a shallow double casket.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with Resurrection of Christ and Twelve Secenes
Description: In the center of the icon is presented the Resurrection of Christ in its variant of Descent to Hell. Around the central field in 12 rectangular frames are presented scenes. Chronologically, starting from the top left, these are Annunciation to Virgin Mary, Nativity of Christ, Presentation of Christ in the Temple, Baptism of Christ (top),  Entry into Jerusalem, Resurrection of Lazarus, Crucifixion of Christ (middle), Transfiguration of Christ (not in place), Ascension of Christ, Old Testament St. Trinity, Dormition of the Virgin (bottom). The icon has a double casket and a rather wide ochre frame. There are holes from the attachment of revetment, which is missing.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon "The Virgin Appearing to St. Sergius of Radonezh"
Description: In the left part of the icon  the Mother of God is shown holding an abbot's staff. Behind her are two apostles (St. Peter and John the Theologian). St. Sergius is standing in front of the Virgin and behind him is St. Nikon. In the background there are stylized buildings and a wall. In the center above the scene in a semi-circlethe Old Testament Holy Trinity  is depicted. The icon has a shallow double casket. The frame is ochre-browinsh.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with Five Russian Saints
Description: The five saints Gleb, Boris, Alexander, Andrew and Avramiy, are represented full-height, together in a symmetrical group. Two of them hold open scrolls. Above them is a cloud segment with damaged painting. The background and frame are decorated with engraved ornaments.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with the Virgin Kazanskaya
Description: The icon is a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan. The icon has a wide orange-red frame.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Pulpit
Description: Pulpit have a two parts. First part has a throne and spiral stairs lead to the second part where was pulpit from where was Gospel readed. On the front of the pulpit is a carved in wood chalice from which rays shine.
Current Location Name: Cathedral of the Nativity of the Theotokos in Sarajevo

Name: Throne
Description: A wooden throne surmounted by a roof supported by four pillars. There are four wooden crosses on the roof.
Current Location Name: Cathedral of the Nativity of the Theotokos in Sarajevo

Name: Chalice
Description: A silver chalice of large dimensions with decorations in four medallions. The medallions were made with the stamping technique, and inside them are depicted Christ,  St. John the Baptist and the Virgin Mary to His left and right (a Deesis) and the Crucifixion opposite the medallion depicting Christ. Above the medallions, at the very top of the cup, an inscription with the prayer that is said during communion runs around the rim of the cup.
Current Location Name: Cathedral of the Nativity of the Theotokos in Sarajevo

Name: Icon with St. John the Forerunner
Description: St. John the Forerunner is represented full-heith, with wings, blessing and holding a chalice with the image of the Christ Sacrafice, as well as an open scroll. In the lower part of the icon there are two life scenes: St. John baptizing in the Jordan River and the Nativity of the Saint. The icon has a shallow double casket. The frame is wide, it was painted in olive green. In the center of the upper frame is the God Father.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Βell in the Skete of Saint Trinity of Kapsokalyvia
Description: This is the bigger bell the Skete has: it was offered by Ivistiona, monk of St Panteleimon Monastery, in August 1894. After this donation, the Skete was obliged to construct a new bell tower  for this big bell.

Name: Βell in the Skete of Saint Trinity of Kapsokalyvia II
Description: This bell was offered in 1862 by a Russian military.

Name: Βell in the Skete of Saint Trinity of Kapsokalyvia III
Description: This is probably one of the three bells that were offered, in April 1873, by a Russian priest, "papa Nifonos the Russian" (see SourcePassage/1114).

Τhe icon is presented in an inscription in Russian as "the miracle-working icon of the Mother of God Akhtyrskaya". It shows the Virgin Mary who looks at the Christ on the Cross (παριστάνει την Θετόκο να ατενίζει τον Εσταυρωμένο).

Name: Icon in two registers
Description: In the top register of the icon are presented The Virgin Eleousa and St. Nicholas as a bust images. In the bottom register are St. George on horseback and three saints, depicted to the knees. The icon has a double casket as a frame. The inscriptions are not preserved.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with St. Demetrius killing King Mamai
Description: St. Demetrius is on horseback, stabbing a fallen horseman with a crown. In the background is depicted a church with a colonnade, under which two figures of maidens hold an icon of St. Demetrius, behind them is an angel. In the top left corner is Christ blessing from the clouds. Angel give the saint a crown. The icon has a shallow double cascet. The inscriptions are unreadable.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with Christ the Saviour Acheiropoieta
Description: The image of Christ is depicted on a red ornamented fabric tied at the two top ends. The background is olive green. The icon has a shallow double casket.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with the Virgin Kazanskaya
Description: The icon is a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan. It has a wide orange-red frame. The clothes are ornamented with engraved motifs. The background is silver.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with the Virgin and the Christ Child
Description: The Virgin holds on her right hand the Christ Child, who has embraced her. Their faces, palms and the feet of the Child, which should have been seen under the revetment, are painted in detail.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon in two registers
Description: The icon is divided into two registers. In the top one are depicted the Nativity and the Descent into Hell. In the bottom row are represented in full length an unknown bishop, St. Tikhon, St. Florus, St. Laurus, an unknown female saint. The icon has a shallow double casket.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with St. Demetrius and St. George
Description: The saints are presented side by side. Under st. Demetrius of Thessalonica's horse is a fallen warrior and St. George behind him is sslaying a dragon, with the rescued maiden at the city gates. Two angels crown the saints. On the top part of the frame is represented Christ Emmanuel in a celestial segment. The icon has a shallow double casket.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon "The Virgin Appearing to St. Sergius of Radonezh"
Description: In the center the Virgin is rendered and behind her to the left, stand apostles Peter and St. John the Theologian. St. Sergius of Radonezh is kneeling before the Virgin with folded hands, and behind him stands St. Nikon, covering his eyes with his hands. In the background in the right part of the icon, behind St. Nikon there is a holy throne, above it a lectern with an open book and icons of the Mother of God with the Christ Child and a bishop Saint. In the top part of the icon, the New Testament Trinity is shown in clouds. The icon has a painted baroque frame.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with the Virgin Tikhvinskaya
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with the Virgin Smolenskaya
Description: The icon is a replica of the miraculous icon of the Mother of God of Smolensk. The icon has a wide orange-red frame.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with Christ Pantocrator
Description: Jesus Christ is presented half-figure with the open Gospel in his left hand and blessing with his right. His cloths are decorated with flower motifs .The icon has a wide orange-red frame.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with the Crucifixion of Christ and Saints
Description: In the center of the icon, the Crucifixion of Christ is depicted and above it, the God of Sabaoth. On the left, there is a bust of the Mother of God, on the right - a bust of St. John the Theologian. In the four parts around the Crucifixion there are: a replica of the icon of the Virgin of Kazan, a bust image of St. Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archangel Michael on horseback and St. George on horseback. The icon has an orange-red frame.
Current Location Name: Museum of the Bulgarian Revival and Constituent Assembly

Name: Icon with Saint Nicholas
Description: The saint is represented to his waist, only his face and hands are depicted, the rest of the space was covered with metal foil revetment (oklad), small parts of which have survived. The icon is placed in a wooden box.

Name: Icon with Christ All-Powerful
Description: Jesus Christ is represented in half figure, blessing and holding a sphere. There are four cherubs around him in the background.

Name: Icon with the Virgin Tikhvinskaya
Description: The icon is a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Tikhvin. The Virgin is represented to her knees, on a golden background.

Name: Icon with Christ All-Powerful
Description: Jesus Christ is represented to his waist, blessing and holding a sphere. The whole icon, except for the face and hands, is covered with metal foil and tinfoil oklad (revetment), the frame is ornamented and decorated with artificial flowers made of fabric. The icon is placed in a wooden casket.

Name: Icon with Christ Pantocrator
Description: Jesus Christ is standing, represented to his waist, blessing and holding sphere.

Name: Icon with the Virgin Kazanskaya
Description: The icon is a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan. The nimbi of the Virgin and the Christ Child are decorated with a painting imitation of metal revetment.

Name: Icon with Sts Cosmas and Damian
Description: The two saints are represented full-length, facing each other, holding medicine boxes and martyr's crosses. Christ blesses them from heaven. The frame and background at  it's top are gold, with engraved ornaments.

Name: Icon with the Virgin and the Christ Child
Description: The icon is an oleograph, pasted in a wooden box and decorated with a revetment. The Virgin Mary is represented to her waist, holding the Christ Child in her left hand. Except for the faces and palms, everything is covered with a thin metal foil.

Name: Icon with the Crucifixion of Christ, the Virgin of Kazan, St. Nicholas, St. Demetrius and St. George (?)
Description: In the center of the icon is depicted the Crucifixion of Christ. Around the four fields of the cross are: a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan, St. Nicholas at the waist, an unknown saint on horseback - probably St. Demetrius, and St. George (?) on horseback. The frame has been orange-red.

Name: Icon with the Virgin of the Sign
Description: The Virgin is presented to his waist, with raised hands, In front of her is the bust of the Christ Childin a round medallion, who  is blessing. The icon has a shallow casket.

Name: Icon with Christ Pantocrator
Description: Christ is represented half-figure, blessing and holding a sphere under which there are clouds.

Name: Icon with Saint Spyridon
Description: Saint spyridon is represented to the waist, blessing and holding an open gospel. The background and his garments are ornamented with engraved motifs. The frame is wide and orange-red.

Name: Icon with Saint Demetrius
Description: St. Dimitrius of Thessaloniki is represented on a horse, spearing a man with a crown, riding a white horse below him. The Holy Mandylion is depicted in the upper left corner of the icon, and a temple is depicted in the right part, in which two maidens are holding an icon of the saint and an angel standing behind them. The frame of the icon is wide and orange-red.

Name: Icon with Christ Pantocrator
Description: Jesus Christ is represented to his waist, blessing and holding an open gospel. The icon has a shallow double casket.

Name: Metal Triptych with Saints
Description: Deisis is represented in the central part of the triptych - Christ is sitting in a throne, Virgin Mary and St. John the Forerunner are standing next to him. On both wings are presented three rows with two saints. Above the central part is the Old Testament Holy Trinity flanked by two seraphim, and above - the Holy Mandylion.

Name: Icon with the Nativity of Christ
Description: The Mother of God is seating in front of the Bethlehem cave, holding a white cloth on which the newborn the Christ Child is lying. Behind the Virgin is Joseph. Three shepherds bow before the Child - one old and two young. The icon has a wide orange-red frame.

Name: Icon with Saint Nicholas
Description: The icon is of the type intended for covering with oklad, in which only the face and hands of the figure are painted. The saint is up to his waist, blessing and holding a gospel. On the surface there are traces of nails that fastened the revetment, which is missing.

Name: Icon with unknown female saint (St. Barbara?)
Description: The icon is of the type intended for covering with oklad/revetment, in which only the face and hands of the figure are painted. The female saint was represented to the waist, with raised palms, facing ¾ to the left. The holy Mandylion is depicted in the left corner. The oklad is missing, but traces of its attachment are visible. A newspaper is glued to the wooden base. Inscriptions missing.

Name: Icon with the Crucifixion of Christ, Virgin of Kazan, archangel Michael and St. George
Description: In the center is placed a cross with the crucified Christ, above it is a bust of the God Sabaoth, on the left and right – busts images of the Virgin Mary and St. John the Theologian. In the four parts around the cross are: a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan, St. Nicholas of Myra to the waist, arch. Michael on horseback and St. George on horseback. The icon has a orange-red frame.

Name: Icon with Christ Pantocrator
Description: Jesus Christ is represented to his waist, blessing and holding a sphere.

Name: Icon with the Entombment of Christ
Description: In the foreground is the dead Christ with his hands folded in front of his chest. Behind him, Virgin Mary, represented to her waist, has her hands raised. The icon has a wide orange-red frame.

Name: Icon with the Crucifixion of Christ, Virgin of Kazan, Archangel Michael and St. George
Description: In the center of the icon is pasted a cross with the crucified Christ, above it is a bust of the God of Sabaoth, on the left and right - the busts of the Virgin and St. John the Theologian. In the four parts around the cross are: a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan, St. Nicholas of Myra to the waist, arch. Michael on horseback and St. George on horseback. The icon has a orange-red frame.

Name: Icon with the Virgin with Christ
Description: Icon depicting Virgin Mary in the type of Glykophilousa, holding in her hands and kissing the Child. The icon is in very good condition.

Name: Icon with Saint Gregory the Theologian
Description: Icon depicting Saint Gregory the Theologian full body and in frontal position. The Saint has his arms opened in supplication. He is dressed in High Priest's garments and he is holding a closed book in his left hand. Minor damages are detected on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Saint Martyr Tryphon
Description: Icon depicting Saint Martyr Tryphon in frontal position and full body. Minor damages are detected on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Christ All-Powerful
Description: Jesus Christ is represented to his waist, blessing and holding a sphere.

Name: Triptych with Virgin Mary with Christ, Saint Peter the Athonite, Venerable Onuphrius, Saint Simeon the God-receiver and Saint Nicholas
Description: Triptych depicting in the central part Virgin Mary entroned, holding the Child and Saint Peter the Athonite and Venerable Onuphrius. Saint Simeon the God-receiver is depicted on the left wing and Saint Nicolas on the right wing. In the central part was a inscription with the creation date, also mentioning thaename of the Moscow Metropolitan Macarius. On the back of the triptych's wings are depicted the instruments of Christ's torture: the Cross, the spear, and cryptograms. The objects suffers from major damages, as the loss of the painting surface and the gold leaf.

Name: Icon with the Transfiguration of Christ
Description: Icon depicting the Transfiguration of Christ on Mount Tabor, in very good condition. Christ is depicted in circular glory, wearing a white garment. He is blessing with his right hand and he is holding a closed scroll in his left. He is flanked by Elijah on the left and Moses on the right. The disciples Peter, James and John are depicted in the lower part of the representation, unable to face the divine light.

Name: Icon with Saint Theodore, Prince of Smolensk and Yaroslav, with his sons David and Constantine
Description: Icon depicting Saint Theodore, Prince of Smolensk and Yaroslav, in frontal position and full body. His right hand is raised at chest level in a gesture of pleasure and he holds a closed scroll with his left hand. The Saint is flanked by his sons, David and Constantine.A part of the icon and the painting surface is destroyed.

Name: Polyptych
Description: Russian polyptych, in the central panel of which is depicted Jesus Christ the Almighty with Saint George, Saint Demetrius and two unidentified great hymnists. On the left wing is depicted Virgin Mary, Archangel Michael, Saint Peter, Saint Basil of Caesarea and Saint John Chrysostom. On the right wing is depicted Saint John the Baptist or the Forerunner, Archangel Gabriel, Saint Paul, Saint Gregory the Theologian and Saint Nicholas. An iscription mentioning the many-sinful Saint John is located on the other side of the icon with the Virgin Mary. The icon has suffered minor damages,

Name: Triptych with Jesus Christ, Virgin Mother and Saint John the Baptist
Description: Triptych in the central of which Jesus Christ is depicted. In the left panel Virgin Mother in the position of deesis is depicted and in the rignt panel Saint John the Baptist in deesis, as well. The panels has suffered from damages and loss of the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Saint First Martyr and Archdeacon Stefan
Description: Icon depicting Saint First Martyr and Archdeacon Stefan with minor damages in the surface.

Name: Icon with the Virgin with Christ
Description: Icon depicting Virgin Mary holding in her arms the Child, in the russian iconographic type of the Virgin of Vladimir, or "Vladimirskaya. The icon was covered with metal revetment (oklad). Major damages are detected on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Saint Basil the Great, John Chrysostom, Gregory the Theologian
Description: Icon depicting the Three Holy Hierarchs, Saint Basil the Great, John Chrysostom, Gregory the Theologian. The icon was covered was metal revetment (oklad). Minor damages are detected on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Jesus Christ
Description: Icon depicting Jesus Christ. The icon was covered with metal revetment (oklad), now lost. Only a small part of the revetment is preserved in the lower part of the icon which has an inscription in Greek. Major damages are detected in the icon.

Name: Icon with the Virgin with Christ
Description: Icon depicting Virgin Hodegetria, holding Jesus Christ in her left hand and pointing him with her right. The icon is covered with metal revetment (oklad) decorated by gemstones in excellent condition.

Name: Icon with Jesus Christ
Description: Icon depicting Jesus Christ Pantokrator. Major damages are detected on the icon.

Name: Icon with the Virgin of Kazan with Christ and one saint
Description: Icon depicting the Virgin of Kazan (Kazanskaya) with Jesus Christ and one saint on the left side of the frame. Part of the icon is destroyed.

Name: Icon with Saint Sava and Saint Simeon
Description: Icon depicting Saint Sava and Saint Simeon in frontal position and full body, blessing with the right hand. Jesus Christ Pantokrator appears inside a semicircle, on the top, between the heads of the Saints. The frame of the icon, the halo of Saint Sava and the inscripions are covered with metal revetment (oklad).The icon is damages especially on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Saint Archdeacon Laurentius
Description: Icon depicting Saint Archdeacon Lavrentius in frontal position and full body. The half part of the icon is destroyed.

Name: Icon with Russian wonderworker archbishop
Description: Icon depicting a Russian wonderworker archbishop. The Saint has his arms opened, blessing with the right and holding a closed book with the left. The icon has major damages on the surface.

Name: Icon with the Resurrection of Christ
Description: Icon depicting the Resurrection of Christ and Descent into Hell. Christ is standingon the broken gates of hell turnig to the right and rising Adam. Eve, with the redmaphorion is standing nearto Adam. On the left side are depicted Solomon and David.The icon has major damages all over the surface.

Name: Icon with Jesus Christ Almighty
Description: Icon depicting Jesus Christ Almighty, blessing with his right hand and holding a closed Gospel in his left. Minor damages are detected on the icon.

Name: Icon with the Virgin with Christ
Description: Icon depicting the Virgin Hodegetria. She is holding in her left hand the Child and she is pointing him with the right one. Jesus Christ is sitting on his Mother's left arm. He is blessing with his right hand and holding a closed scroll in his left. The frame of the icon and the halos were coverd with metal revetment (oklad). The icon is severely damaged with missing parts.

Name: Icon with Saint Nicholas
Description: Icon depicting Saint Nicholas from the waist up. He is blessing with his right hand and holding a closed Gospel with his left. On either side of his head, Jesus Christ and Virgin Mary are depicted, blessing the Saint. The icon is seriously damaged.

Name: Icon with the Virgin with Christ
Description: Icon depicting Virgin Mary holding in her arms the Child, in the russian iconographic type of the Virgin of Vladimir. Only minor damages are detected on the icon.

Name: Icon with Myrrhbearers at the Tomb
Description: Icon depicting the Myrrhbearers visiting Christ's Tomb. In the icon is depicted the Angel, with white garments, sitting on the open and empty Tomb, informing them about the Resurrection of Christ. The icon is in good condition.

Name: Icon with Jesus Christ
Description: Icon depicting Jesus Christ sitting on a throne and his feet are placed on a pedestal. He is rising his right hand in a gesture of blessing, while he is holding a closed codex with his left. The icon was covered with metal revetment (oklad). The icon suffers from major damages.

Name: Icon with the Virgin Smolenskaya with Christ
Description: Virgin Mary is depicted from the waist up, holding Jesus Christ in her left hand. The Child, portraited in frontal pose is resting on his Mother's arm and at the same time he is blessing with his right hand. The heads of both figures are surrounded by a halo. The  icon is in very good condition.

Name: Icon with the Virgin Eleousa or Kykkotisa with Christ
Description: Icon depicting the Virgin in the iconography of Virgin Kykkotisa. Virgin Mary is depicted from the waist up, holding Jesus Christ in her arms and covering her head with the veil. The Child, is resting on his Mother's arm and holding an open scroll with his left hand. The heads of both figures are surrounded by a halo. The icon was covered with metal revetment (oklad). The icon is  in good condition.

Name: Icon with the Holy Trinity
Description: Icon depicting the Holy Trinity of the Old Testamen. The three angels are sitting around a white table. Behind them a building is depicted, as well as a tree and a mountain. On the right and left side of the frame two saints are depicted, and one of them is one is the Venerable Ephronius of Pskov. The icon is in good condition.

Name: Icon with Unknown Wonderworker from Perm
Description: Icon depicting an Icon with unknown wonderworker from Perm (Russia) in the prayer possition. Jesus Chrst ia appearing from the  upper right corner, giving an open scroll to the Saint. The icon is  partially destroyed on the frontal part

Name: Icon with the Nativity of Christ with the Flight into Egypt
Description: Icon depicting the Nativity of Christ and the Flight into Egypt. In the middle of the synthesis the Child is depicted in His cradle. Virgin Mary is standing near to the Child, while the Three Kings are visiting Jesus, bringing him gifts. In the lower part the icon, on the left, Joseph is depicted, while on the right side is the representation of the Flight into Egypt.The icon suffers from major damages.

Name: Icon with the Nativity of the Virgin
Description: Ιcon depicting the Nativity of the Virgin. Anna sits on on her bed after the childbirth, while Joachim  sits on a throne right across her. Below Anna's bed the infant's bath is depicted , prepaired. Minor damages are detected on the surface of the icon,

Name: Icon with the Virgin with Christ
Description: Icon depicting Virgin Mary holding in her arms the Child, in the russian iconographic type of the Virgin of Vladimir, or "Vladimirskaya. Jesus Christ in her right arm and with her left hand she is touching his right hand, while the Child is resting his face on hers. The icon was covered by metal revetment (oklad). Major damages are detected on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with the Virgin and Christ
Description: Icon depicting the Virgin Hodegetria. She is holding in her left hand the Child and with the right she is pointing him with the right one.The icon is damaged in the frame and the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Saint Sophia
Description: Icon depicting Saint Sophia, enthroned, surrounded by Virgin Mary on the left and John the Baptist on the right, in deesis. Jesus Christ is appearing above the depiction of Saint Sophia, with His arms opened, blessing. Above Jesus, angels are depicted in an arc. The icon suffers from major damages on the painting surface.

Name: Icon with Christ, the Virgin, the Forerunner and the Twelve Apostles
Description: Icon depicting Jesus Christ, on the top of the scene, blessing and surrounded by the Virgin on the left and John on the right, in deesis, inside circular scrolls. Below, in the next three rows, the twelve Apostles are depicted. It is probably an icon of Christ the True Vine. The icon has major damages.

Name: Icon "The Virgin Appearing in Pochaev Mount"
Description: Above is a full-length Virgin in aureole, holding a scepter. Below her on a hill is an imprint of her step from which flows a stream. A monk and a shepherd with a flock of sheep are kneeling in front of the hill, looking at the Virgin. The icon has an engraved ornamented frame. The back is covered with plush fabric.

Name: Icon with Sts. Samon, Gury and Aviv
Description: The three saints are full-length on a tricolor background. A miniature image of the Holy Mandylion is depicted at the top.

Name: Chalice
Description: Gilted silver chalice decorated by chased wine scrolls and medallions with representations of Jesus Christ and other Holy persons. The cup of the silver glilted chalice is decorated by chased wine scrolls, medallions with representations of Jesus Christ and other Holy persons and an incised inscription around the rim. The stem is decorated by incised vertical lines and a central knob and the foot is also decorated by embossed floral motif.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Silver Chalice of russian art
Description: Gilted silver chalice decorated by incised linear motifs and medallions with representations of Jesus Christ and other Holy persons. The cup of the silver glilted chalice is decorated by incised linear motifs, medallions with representations of Jesus Christ and other Holy persons made by the repoussé technique and an incised inscription around the rim. The stem is decorated by a central knob and the foot is also decorated by medallions.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Chalice
Description: Gilted silver chalice decorated by chased wine scrolls and medallions with representations of Jesus Christ, Virgin Mary and other Holy persons. The cup of the silver  chalice is decorated by chased wine scrolls, medallions with representations of Jesus Christ, Virgin Mary and other Holy persons and an incised inscription around the rim. The stem is decorated by incised vertical lines and a central knob and the foot is also decorated by embossed floral motif.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Holy Gospel
Description: Russian gospel with silver gilted cover, depicting on the front the Resurrection of Christ and the four Evangelists with their symbols, inside oval medallions.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Icon in three registers
Description: The icon is divided into three registers. In the first are: the Virgin Mary of Kazan, Resurrection of Christ and St. Nicholas, depicted to his waist. Second Register: St. Zosima and St. Savatius in full length, a guarding Angel in full length and a full-length images of St. Florus and Laurus. Third register: St. George on horseback, St. Paraskeva, St. Nikita in full length. The icon has a wide orange-red frame.

Name: Icon with the Virgin Kazanskaya
Description: The icon is a replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan. It is covered with silver revetment, which was made in Moscow in 1887, initials of the assayer N.K., of the master...Z. The back is clothed with reddish silk.

Name: Icon with Christ All-Powerful
Description: Jesus Christ is represented to the waist, blessing and holding an open gospel. The icon is covered with silver revetment. The back is clothed with red velvet.

Name: Icon with Saint George
Description: St. George is on horseback, stabbing a dragon. In the background there is a city, in front of whose gates stands a female figure. The icon is covered with silver revetment. The back is covered with beige velvet.

Name: Icon with Saint Nicholas
Description: Saint Nicholas is represented to the waist, blessing and holding a gospel. The icon is covered with a metal revetment that leaves only the face and palms visible. According to the style and ornamentation, the revetment was made in the Bulgarian lands at the beginning of the 20th century. The back is covered with bleached velvet.

Name: Blessing Cross
Description: Blessing cross with the enameled representation of the Crucified Jesus in the center. The figures of the Virgin and John are detected on the horizontal antennas of the cross. Above Christ's head the Father is depicted blessing. Below the cross Christ is depicted praying.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Gold-embroidered epigonation
Description: Gold-embroidered epigonation, with the Resurrection of Christ in the center. In each corner of the square epigonation there is also a representation of an angel. Each side of the square is decorated with gold-embroidered floral decoration and inside there is an inscription of the troparion of Easter.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Gold-embroidered Velvet Epitaphios of Russian art
Description: Gold-embroidered velvet Εpitaphios depicting Christ's dead body. His body is surrounded by mourning Virgin Mary, Angels, Apostles and Myrrhbearers.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Gold-embroidered velvet Εpitaphios of Russian art
Description: Gold-embroidered velvet Εpitaphios depicting Christ's dead body.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Icon with the Virgin Kazanskaya
Description: Replica of the miraculous icon of the Virgin of Kazan. The icon has a wide orange frame.

Name: Icon with the Virgin and the Christ Child
Description: The Virgin is represented to the waist, holding the Christ Child in her left hand. The icon has a wide shallow casket.

Name: Icon with Saint Nicholas
Description: he saint is depicted to his knees, blessing and holding an open gospel. In the background on either side of his head are two round medallions with busts of Christ and the Virgin. On the back of the icon there are traces of two wax stamps.

Name: ICon with Saint Demetrius
Description: St. Demetrius is on horseback, spearing a fallen warrior. An angel descends from heaven and crowns the saint. From the upper left corner, the Hand of God blesses him. On the right is a church, in which two maidens hold an icon of St. Demetrius, an angel stands behind them. The icon has a shallow double casket.

Name: Icon with Sts. Samon, Gury and Aviv
Description: The saints Samon, Gury and Aviv are depicted full-length on a three color background. A miniature image of the Holy Mandylion is depicted at the top of the scene.

Name: Diskarion
Description: Diskarion depicting the Crucifixion of Jesus Christ.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Museum of the Holy Metropolis of Serres and Nigritis - Repository 'Ψυχῆς Ἄκος'

Name: Diskarion

On either side the instruments of the Crucifixion and the Symbols of the Passion are represented. In the three free antennae the Bridegroom wearing the tunic and the crown of thorns is depicted in spherical icons, as well as Jesus carrying the cross of Martyrdom and Jesus praying.

Name: I Agia Skepe (the Sacred Protection)
Description: Icon depicting the Intercession of the Virgin or the Protection of Our Most Holy Lady. Description provided by the Museum in Greek: Η εικόνα χωρίζεται οριζόντια σε δύο μέρη. Στο επάνω μέρος εικονίζεται στο κέντρο η Παναγία όρθια μέσα σε δόξα με ανοιχτά και υψωμένα τα χέρια σε στάση δέησης. Κρατά τεντωμένο το μαφόριό της με το οποίο, συμβολικά, σκεπάζει τους πιστούς και τους προστατεύει από κάθε κακό. Δεξιά της, στην αριστερή γωνία της εικόνας προβάλλει μέσα από σύννεφα ο Χριστός. Εικονίζεται ως τη μέση, στραμμένος προς την Παναγία την οποία ευλογεί με το δεξί του χέρι, ενώ με το αριστερό κρατά κλειστό Ευαγγέλιο. Στα αριστερά της συμπαραστέκεται την Παναγία λευκοντυμένος άγγελος που τον ακολουθεί χορός Αποστόλων. Στο κάτω μέρος της εικόνας στο κέντρο και σε υψηλό υποπόδιο εικονίζεται όρθιος, ντυμένος με κοκκινο-πορτοκαλί αμφίεση ο Άγιος Ρωμανός ο Μελωδός, που πλαισιώνεται, από τα αριστερά του, από τον Ανδρέα το Σαλό, που με υψωμένο το χέρι του δείχνει την Παναγία. Δίπλα του εικονίζεται ο ακόλουθός του Επιφάνιος, που αργότερα έγινε Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινουπόλεως. Δεξιά του Αγίου Ρωμανού εικονίζεται πιθανώς ο Πατριάρχης Κωνσταντινουπόλεως Νικόλαος Α΄Μυστικός, συνοδευόμενος από πρεσβύτερο ακόλουθό του. Σε υψηλότερο επίπεδο εικονίζονται όρθιοι κάτω από κιβώριο η Αυτοκράτειρα και ο Αυτοκράτορας Λέων ο Σοφός (886-911) επί της βασιλείας του οποίου έλαβε χώρα στο ναό των Βλαχερνών το όραμα στο οποίο αναφέρεται και περιγράφει η εικόνα. Η τεχνοτροπία της εικόνας και οι ρωσικές επιγραφές της παραπέμπουν σε ρωσικό εργαστήριο.
Current Location Name: Ecclesiastical Byzantine Museum of Mytilene, Lesvos

Name: Polyptych
Description:
Metal polyptych which consists of four casted panels decorated with enamel, in good condition. 
From left to right, on the flame-shaped arches of the panels, the iconographic themes of the Crucifixion, the Holy Trinity, the Exaltation of the Holy Cross and the Virgin Mary in Glory are detected.
In the lower part of the panels: The first panel depicts the Annunciation of the Virgin, the Nativity of Christ, the Birth of the Virgin, and the Presentation of the Virgin in the Temple.The second panel depicts the Presentation of Christ in the Temple, the Baptism of Christ, the Transfiguration, and the Entry into Jerusalem. The third panel depicts the Descent into Hell, the the Ascension of Jesus, the Pentecost, and the Dormition of the Virgin. The fourth panel depicts the litany of four miraculous icons of the Virgin.
